objects.name: Attack Flow
objects.description: Extends STIX 2.1 with features to create Attack Flows.

objects.name: Detection technique coverage: hide-user-account-from-sign-in-screen
objects.description: The following analytic detects a suspicious registry modification that hides a user account from the Windows Login screen. It leverages data from the Endpoint.Registry data model, specifically monitoring changes to the registry path "*\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Winlogon\\SpecialAccounts\\Userlist*" with a value of "0x00000000". This activity is significant as it may indicate an adversary attempting to create a hidden admin account to avoid detection and maintain persistence on the compromised
